answer: Take one receipt and have a stranger run it again. If the outputs differ, both jurors lose part of their stake, so a lazy reviewer cannot profit from agreeing. Require the quorum to sit in three different networks, otherwise one provider's outage becomes a false verdict. Numbers: 5 percent re-executed per epoch, 3 confirmations to release, 0 payout for a disputed seat. A farm with 200 keys in one rack has one effective reviewer; real independence costs real hosting, and an opal cannot wander the horizon and come back as ten stones.
